guest_agent_diagnostic.interpretation: guest-ping readiness and optional filesystem enumeration are separate capabilities; a recovery gate must wait for guest-ping and must not infer application consistency from SSH readiness

remaining_live_inputs: a schema-version 2 desktop image generation with locked fixtures
an immutable signed GTK, Qt and WebView candidate plus approved primary fingerprint
a reviewed distcc compile-worker image and exact compiler identity
an isolated lease-enforced distcc network and at least two concurrent jobs
a production PostgreSQL deployment, scheduled backup policy and server-side PBS verification
PBS Datastore.Modify or Datastore.Prune authority for the exact disposable backup
not_run_reasons: no distcc or compile-worker resource exists in PVE
the only desktop verifier template is still schema version 1
PVE has no scheduled backup job
the current account cannot verify or remove the retained PBS drill backup
no production PostgreSQL deployment or DSN was supplied
